title: ViBench 2.0: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Software Building
abstract: arXiv:2611.05620v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On Replit, our agentic engineering platform, users now build entire products without writing code, through successive feature requests to an agent. Yet existing coding benchmarks evaluate single, fully specified tasks, and many are near saturation. We introduce ViBench 2.0, a benchmark for long-horizon software building that we use to select our platform's models. Its 17 full-stack web products, modeled on widely used software, grow over 241 feature requests and are judged only when finished, as a user would judge them: a browser agent runs 544 test plans, and a build passes only if every plan does, under a grading protocol validated to keep this strict score reliable. Evaluating nine models, we find a reliability gap: the three strongest pass up to 98% of test plans yet deliver a fully working product in at most 65% of builds, and no open-weight model delivers one. The gap is closing fast: across three releases of one model family, pass

translated_title: ViBench 2.0：一个面向长周期软件构建的基准测试
translated_abstract: 在 Replit——我们的智能体工程平台上，用户如今无需编写代码，只需向智能体连续提出功能需求，就能构建完整的产品。然而，现有的编程基准测试评估的是单一的、完全明确指定的任务，且许多基准已接近饱和。我们提出了 ViBench 2.0，一个用于长周期软件构建的基准测试，我们用它来为平台选择模型。它包含 17 个以广泛使用的软件为原型的全栈 Web 产品，通过 241 个功能需求逐步演进，并且只有在完成时才像用户那样被评判：由一个浏览器智能体运行 544 个测试计划，只有所有计划都通过，构建才算通过，其评分协议经过验证以确保这一严格分数的可靠性。通过对九个模型的评估，我们发现了一个可靠性差距：最强的三个模型最多能通过 98% 的测试计划，但在构建中最多只有 65% 能交付完全可用的产品，而没有任何开放权重模型能做到这一点。这一差距正在快速缩小：在某个模型家族的三个版本中，通过率（原文在此处截断）
tldr: ViBench 2.0 是一个用于长周期软件构建的基准测试，通过 17 个随 241 个功能需求逐步演进的全栈 Web 产品和 544 个浏览器智能体测试计划进行严格评估，揭示了最强模型通过高达 98% 的测试计划却仅有最多 65% 的构建能交付完全可用产品的可靠性差距。
en_tdlr: ViBench 2.0 is a benchmark for long-horizon software building featuring 17 full-stack web products evolving over 241 feature requests and evaluated via 544 browser-agent test plans, revealing a reliability gap where the strongest models pass up to 98% of test plans yet deliver fully working products in at most 65% of builds.
